parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: SecurityIpGroupName
parameters.description:
The group name of the whitelist group of IP addresses.

It starts with lowercase letters and ends with lowercase letters or numbers. It can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, and should be 2~32 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro delete-tenant-security-ip-group --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id t4louaeei0000 --security-ip-group-name paytest --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DeleteTenantSecurityIpGroup --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4louaeei0000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SecurityIpGroupName paytest
